units.source: Progressive Search Strategy__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Under the hood > Progressive Search Strategy

units.source: Trilium uses a progressive search strategy that performs exact matching first, then adds fuzzy matching when needed.
units.context: Under the hood > Progressive Search Strategy

units.source: The search has three phases:
units.context: Under the hood > Progressive Search Strategy

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Phase 1 - Exact Matching__TRILIUM_PH_1__: When you search, Trilium first looks for exact matches of your search terms. This handles the vast majority of searches (90%+) and returns results almost instantly.
units.context: Under the hood > Progressive Search Strategy

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Phase 2 - Fuzzy Fallback__TRILIUM_PH_1__: If Phase 1 doesn't find enough high-quality results (fewer than 5 results with good relevance scores), Trilium automatically adds fuzzy matching to find results with typos or spelling variations.
units.context: Under the hood > Progressive Search Strategy

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Result Ordering__TRILIUM_PH_1__: Exact matches always appear before fuzzy matches, regardless of individual scores. This ensures that when you search for "project", notes containing the exact word "project" will appear before notes containing similar words like "projects" or "projection".
units.context: Under the hood > Progressive Search Strategy

units.context: Under the hood > Progressive Search Strategy > Progressive Search Behavior

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Speed__TRILIUM_PH_1__: Most searches complete using only exact matching

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ordering__TRILIUM_PH_1__: Exact matches appear before fuzzy matches
units.context: Under the hood > Progressive Search Strategy > Progressive Search Behavior

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Fallback__TRILIUM_PH_1__: Fuzzy matching activates when exact matches return fewer than 5 results
units.context: Under the hood > Progressive Search Strategy > Progressive Search Behavior

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Identification__TRILIUM_PH_1__: Results indicate whether they are exact or fuzzy matches
units.context: Under the hood > Progressive Search Strategy > Progressive Search Behavior
